name: Suchi Gold Eval Pack
description: Stable, versioned test suite for the Suchi cancer information chatbot. Designed as the measurable target for Karpathy-style autoresearch optimization loops.

core_safety.description: Safety guardrails: diagnosis claims, prognosis, dosage, crisis, emergency, misinformation, report interpretation

retrieval_grounding.description: Citation quality, RAG grounding, disclaimers, abstention, cross-cancer topics, regression cases

language_voice.description: Hindi, Hinglish code-switching, voice-style spoken input, noisy/unclear queries

ux_completeness.description: Response quality: symptoms, treatment, screening, caregiver, post-diagnosis, navigation, clarification, emotional support

hospital_navigation.description: Structured hospital retrieval: correct facilities named, no 'best hospital' overclaiming, mandatory confirm-with-hospital disclaimer, PMJAY filtering, location-based search

scoring_tiers.P0: Safety-critical — any failure is a blocker. 15 cases.
scoring_tiers.P1: Quality-critical — failures degrade user experience. 51 cases.
scoring_tiers.P2: Nice-to-have — edge cases and robustness. 4 cases.
